parameters.name: X-ERP-Counterparty-Contract
parameters.description: Exact client compatibility declaration. Required for every command and for reads containing zero-role accounts. Before enabling commands, require the matching server acknowledgment on a fresh, successful, validated GET bound to the current API origin, actor/session, selected company and generation. An error response never establishes readiness.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Code, legalName or tradeName contains search; Unicode trim + NFC, Turkish CI/AS.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Optional Party kind.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Repeatable Party role filter; one visible account must satisfy roleMatch.

parameters.name: roleMatch
parameters.description: Role matching mode; default any.

parameters.name: partyState
parameters.description: Global Party state; default active.

parameters.name: accountState
parameters.description: Visible company-account state; default all.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Keyset sort; default code.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Sort direction; default asc.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Page size; default 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque authenticated cursor bound to actor, session, scope and normalized query.

parameters.name: includeCount
parameters.description: Return exact filtered authorized distinct Party count; default false.

X-ERP-Counterparty-Contract.description: Optional server acknowledgment, present only after the client-contract filter accepts the exact request declaration. It can accompany handler-generated errors; errors before the filter (including authentication, company resolution and body binding) may omit it. Its presence on an error is not command success or client readiness. Readiness requires a fresh, successful, validated GET with the matching acknowledgment bound to the current API origin, actor/session, selected company and generation. Absence on an error is not proof of an old server.

CounterpartyAddressChange.description: An upsert of a new UUID requires purpose (billing/delivery/operational), countryCode (two ASCII letters, stored uppercase), and line1. Existing fields may be omitted. No official/global address is changed. Country validation is syntactic, not an official country registry check. deactivate/reactivate requires an existing child and no value fields.

CounterpartyContactChange.description: New contacts require displayName and purpose. Channels are explicit operations; missing channels are retained. A contact never creates an Identity user or grants permissions.

CounterpartyContactChannelChange.description: New channel requires kind (phone/email) and value. Kind is immutable for a child UUID. Phone value maximum 32; email maximum 254. Extension maximum 10, phone only. deactivate/reactivate requires an existing child and no value fields.

CounterpartyContactInformationChanges.description: Omitted fields retain their values. Null/trim-empty clears optional text. Collections are explicit child operations, not replacement lists. Null collections are invalid. An omitted child is never deleted or deactivated. Phone prefixes, punctuation and leading zeroes are preserved. Email format is not deliverability verification; website permits http/https without credentials.

PartyRole.description: Optional legacy trade classification. Zero means no specified classification; values 1 through 15 retain their stored flags. This value does not grant user permissions or restrict buying and selling.

UpdateCounterpartyContactInformation.description: Updates only the selected company account. expectedVersion is its logical Version as canonical decimal TEXT (1..9223372036854775807), never SQL rowversion bytes or a JSON number. Missing fields are unchanged; explicit null clears optional text. A 409 version_conflict requires a fresh GET; the error does not echo numeric versions.
